quizName:
Hardest Questions in Alabama
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that turning right is not allowed at this location. You must follow this sign.

questions.question: When must vehicles have liability insurance?

options.text: Only when used on an interstate.
Only when operated by a minor.

questions.explanation: All vehicles must have liability insurance at all times. This law protects people if you cause an accident.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down and adjust your speed to avoid accidents and brake problems.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign means traffic will enter your lane from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: If you feel drowsy while driving, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop at a rest area and take a break. You can nap, stretch, or let someone else drive. Caffeine pills are not safe and will not replace sleep.

questions.question: What should you do when a blind pedestrian with a guide dog or white cane approaches?

options.text: Honk so they know to clear the way.

questions.explanation: You must stop and let a blind person with a guide dog or white cane cross safely before you continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet roads are slippery and dangerous. Slow down because your car will take longer to stop on wet pavement.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that turning right is not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter at this location. It is posted on one-way streets and expressway ramps to keep you from entering the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to watch for bicycles crossing the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that pedestrians cross in this area. Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: If you are angry after an argument, what should you do before driving?

options.text: Play loud music so you won't think about the argument.
Take a few minutes to calm down.
Drive on the interstate to let off steam.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down.
questions.explanation: Your emotions affect your driving. If you are angry, wait until you feel calm before driving. You need to focus on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces for people with disabilities. Only vehicles with a disability license plate or placard can park here.

questions.question: What should you do at a red traffic light?

options.text: Speed up to quickly cross the intersection.

questions.explanation: Stop at a red traffic light. Wait until the light turns green before you drive.

questions.question: If you encounter an aggressive driver, what should you do?
questions.explanation: The safest choice is to get out of their way. Do not compete with other drivers. This keeps you safe.

questions.question: If a police officer signals you to stop but the light is green, what should you do?

options.text: Do what the vehicle in front of you does.

questions.explanation: Always obey a police officer's signals, even if they conflict with traffic lights or signs.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in work zones?

options.text: Follow the driver in front of you closely.
Pass the driver in front of you as soon as you can.
Keep a safe distance and do not tailgate.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep a safe distance and do not tailgate.
questions.explanation: In work zones, increase your distance from other vehicles. Avoid tailgating and watch for barriers, equipment, workers, and other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: Which driving skills are affected by alcohol and drugs?
questions.explanation: Alcohol and drugs hurt many skills needed for safe driving. They slow your reaction time, hurt your coordination, reduce your alertness, and make it hard to focus.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road where traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, you should:

options.text: Drive faster to get to your destination sooner.
Find a safe place to park and take a short nap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Find a safe place to park and take a short nap.
questions.explanation: Watch for signs of fatigue while driving. If you struggle to keep your eyes open, drift from your lane, or need to turn up the radio to stay awake, you are too tired. Find a safe place to park and rest.

questions.question: If you get tired while driving, you should:

options.text: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.
questions.explanation: To avoid tired driving, take a break every hour on long trips. If possible, share driving with another person so you can sleep while they drive.

questions.question: If you get tired while driving, the best thing to do is:

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: Stop to rest or change drivers. Being tired slows your thinking and reactions, making driving unsafe.

questions.question: At a crosswalk:

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crossings, but they must obey traffic signals. Where there is no traffic signal, you must stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk, whether it is marked or unmarked.

questions.question: If you see lowered gates and flashing red lights at a railroad crossing, you should:

options.text: Drive around the gates if you don't see a train.
Stop well behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, then proceed when the gates are raised.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop well behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, then proceed when the gates are raised.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when warned by signs, flashing lights, or flaggers. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: Like alcohol and drugs, drowsiness can:
questions.explanation: Not getting enough sleep causes poor driving. Like drugs and alcohol, sleepiness slows your reaction time, reduces awareness, and affects your judgment.

questions.question: You want to turn right at a corner. A pedestrian with a guide dog is waiting to cross in front of you. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off your engine until the person crosses.
Tell the pedestrian when to cross.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians using guide dogs or white canes have the right-of-way at all times. Let them cross first.

questions.question: If you must stop on an interstate highway in an emergency, you should:

options.text: Honk your horn to get other drivers' attention.
Get out and flag down the first vehicle that passes.
Pull off the road, turn on emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle if you can.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle if you can.
questions.explanation: If you must stop on an interstate shoulder, turn on your emergency flashers and stay inside your vehicle if possible. Walking on an interstate is very dangerous because traffic moves at high speeds.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means "stop."

questions.question: If a truck or bus is turning right where you also need to turn right, you should:

options.text: Turn before the truck or bus does.
Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning.
questions.explanation: Do not try to fit your vehicle between a turning truck or bus and the curb. This can cause a serious crash. Wait until the truck or bus completes its turn.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: When you see a school bus stopped with its stop arm out and red lights flashing, you should:

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait.
Honk your horn before passing on the left.
Continue driving when you think the children are done exiting.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait.
questions.explanation: When a school bus stops with its stop arm extended and red lights flashing, come to a complete stop. Stay stopped until the stop arm is pulled in and the lights stop flashing.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No left turn is allowed here.
You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn is allowed here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: In a vehicle with airbags, where should children age 12 and under ride?

options.text: The bed of a pick-up truck.

questions.explanation: Airbags can be dangerous for children. Anyone age 12 or under should sit in the back seat of a vehicle with airbags.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.
